blocks.title: databricks.yml tối thiểu
blocks.code:
bundle:
  name: orders_etl

include:
  - resources/*.yml

artifacts:
  python_artifact:
    type: whl
    build: uv build --wheel

variables:
  catalog:
    description: Target catalog

targets:
  dev:
    mode: development
    default: true
    variables:
      catalog: dev_catalog
  prod:
    mode: production
    variables:
      catalog: prod_catalog

notes.md: `include` gom mọi file resource vào bundle
`artifacts` build wheel bằng `uv build --wheel` lúc `bundle deploy`
`variables` đổi catalog theo target, tham chiếu bằng `${var.catalog}`
`mode: development` thêm prefix `[dev user]` và pause schedule

blocks.title: Job dùng wheel trên serverless
blocks.code:
resources:
  jobs:
    orders_job:
      name: orders_job
      tasks:
        - task_key: main
          python_wheel_task:
            package_name: orders_etl
            entry_point: main
          environment_key: default
      environments:
        - environment_key: default
          spec:
            environment_version: "5"
            dependencies:
              - ../dist/*.whl
              - simplejson==3.19.3

notes.md: Python wheel task bắt buộc có `environment_key`
`environment_version` chọn Python và bộ thư viện có sẵn

rows.says: Serverless job still runs old code after a new wheel was deployed
rows.why: Serverless cache virtual environment theo dependency; docs yêu cầu đổi version number khi đổi code package.

blocks.title: Pin version
blocks.md:
- Serverless best practice: pin `==version` trong requirements

blocks.title: SQL UDF và Unity Catalog Python UDF
blocks.code:
-- SQL UDF: inline SQL, no Python process
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION main.etl.mask_email(email STRING)
RETURNS STRING
RETURN concat('***@', split_part(email, '@', 2));

-- Unity Catalog Python UDF with pinned dependencies
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION main.etl.parse_payload(raw STRING)
RETURNS STRING
LANGUAGE PYTHON
DETERMINISTIC
ENVIRONMENT (
  dependencies = '["simplejson==3.19.3"]',
  environment_version = '6'
)
AS $$
import simplejson
return str(simplejson.loads(raw).get("order_id"))
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION main.etl.parse_payload TO `analysts`;

notes.md: Tên 3 phần nên function được lưu trong Unity Catalog
`DETERMINISTIC` cho phép optimizer tối ưu query
`ENVIRONMENT` khai báo dependency theo format requirements của pip
`environment_version` bắt buộc khi có `ENVIRONMENT`
Người gọi cần `EXECUTE` trên function

blocks.title: Isolation và dependency trong volume
blocks.md:
- Python UDF cùng owner và session dùng chung isolation environment từ Databricks Runtime 18.1

# create a job from a JSON spec, then trigger it
databricks jobs create --json @orders_job.json

blocks.alt: For each task process_countries wrapping the nested task process_countries_iteration, with Inputs set to a JSON array of country codes and an optional Concurrency field

credit.label: Databricks docs: Use a For each task to run another task in a loop

blocks.title: Cùng job viết trong bundle
blocks.code:
resources:
  jobs:
    orders_flow:
      name: orders_flow
      tasks:
        - task_key: ingest_orders
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: ../src/ingest.ipynb
        - task_key: check_bad
          depends_on:
            - task_key: ingest_orders
          condition_task:
            op: GREATER_THAN
            left: "{{tasks.ingest_orders.values.bad_records}}"
            right: "0"
        - task_key: quarantine
          depends_on:
            - task_key: check_bad
              outcome: "true"
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: ../src/quarantine.ipynb
        - task_key: process_tables
          depends_on:
            - task_key: check_bad
              outcome: "false"
          for_each_task:
            inputs: "{{tasks.ingest_orders.values.tables}}"
            concurrency: 4
            task:
              task_key: process_table
              notebook_task:
                notebook_path: ../src/process.ipynb
                base_parameters:
                  table: "{{input}}"

notes.md: `op` nhận `EQUAL_TO`, `NOT_EQUAL`, `GREATER_THAN`, `GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL`, `LESS_THAN`, `LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL`
`outcome` chọn nhánh true hoặc false
`inputs` là JSON array, task value hoặc job parameter
`concurrency` giới hạn số iteration song song

blocks.title: Transformation có test
blocks.code:
# src/orders_etl/transforms.py
from pyspark.sql import DataFrame, functions as F

def clean_orders(df: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    return df.where(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())

def add_net(df: DataFrame, tax: float) -> DataFrame:
    return df.withColumn("net", F.col("amount") * (1 - tax))

# tests/test_transforms.py
from pyspark.testing import assertDataFrameEqual, assertSchemaEqual
from orders_etl.transforms import clean_orders, add_net

def test_pipeline(spark):              # fixture from conftest.py
    src = spark.createDataFrame(
        [(1, 100.0), (None, 5.0)], "order_id INT, amount DOUBLE")
    out = src.transform(clean_orders).transform(add_net, 0.1)
    expected = spark.createDataFrame(
        [(1, 100.0, 90.0)], "order_id INT, amount DOUBLE, net DOUBLE")
    assertSchemaEqual(out.schema, expected.schema)
    assertDataFrameEqual(out, expected)

notes.md: Hàm nhận và trả DataFrame nên ghép được bằng `transform`
`transform(func, *args)` truyền thêm tham số từ Spark 3.3
`assertSchemaEqual` so tên cột, kiểu, thứ tự cột
`assertDataFrameEqual` mặc định không xét thứ tự row
